description:
Don't miss the Introducing Faye Trailer for God of War Laufey, the latest third-person action-adventure series developed by Sony Santa Monica. Players can join God of War Laufey’s Narrative Director and Lead Writer to get the rundown on bringing Faye to the forefront of this grand adventure. Head into the afterlife of the gods in God of War Laufey, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#IGN #Gaming #PS5

description:
Watch the Meet the Cast Trailer for God of War Laufey, the latest third-person action-adventure series developed by Sony Santa Monica. Players can see the cast for the next step in the God of War IP, with Deborah Ann Woll reprising her role as the legendary warrior Faye alongside Jack Quaid as Phranque, and Perlina Lau as Rue. God of War Laufey is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: God of War Laufey - Meet The Cast Behind The Scenes | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The next entry in the iconic God of War series is on the way. 

This time you play as Laufey (or 'Faye'), Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother. Awakening elsewhere after her body is burned, Faye must discover where she is, and how to get back to her family. 

God of War Laufey is currently in development for PlayStation 5.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: God of War Laufey - Gameplay Reveal | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a new look at ILL, a realistic first-person action horror game that takes place in a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity.

This is the first title under the Mundfish Powerhouse label and the first project from Team Clout studio, and the teams are aiming to "create a game that will claw its way into your consciousness and expose your true fears, layer by layer."

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: ILL - Official Story Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
A new update is coming to Marathon, including a new zone, a new shell, new weapons, mods, cores, implants, and The Cradle.

The Nightfall update Open Play Week is live June 2 - June 9.

Tau Ceti still hungers. Do you?

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Marathon - Official Season 2: Gameplay Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Until Dawn is returning for a second entry in 2027, and this time players will join a group of ghost hunters as they "chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman's chilling story of something far darker than they bargained for."

Once again, the characters' lives will be in the players hand, and their choices will determine who makes it off the island and who meets a grisly fate.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Until Dawn 2 - Official Reveal Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Jesse Faden fought the Hiss as the newly-christened head of the Federal Bureau of Control, and now her brother Dylan has awakened from his long slumber. The Hiss has broken containment, escaping the confines of the Oldest House. Dylan may have been a tool of the Hiss, but now he must take the fight to them to save what's left of Manhattan... and our reality. 

Control: Resonant comes to PS5 on Sept. 24, 2026, and you can pre-order now.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Control: Resonant - Official Pre-Order Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Moon Studios' No Rest for the Wicked will finally enter Version 1.0 in October 2026 on PC and PS5, and it will feature 100+ hours of content, new powerful weapons, new bosses and enemies, new areas, a re-imagined class system, and much more.
title: No Rest For The Wicked - Official 1.0 Release Window Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Stuntman: Hollywood was revealed at the State of Play showcase and it will let players become Hollywood's "most sought-after stuntman." You'll get to perform scenes inspired by such blockbuster movies as Back to the Future, and show how a little bit of danger can go a long way in Hollywood.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Stuntman: Hollywood - Official Reveal Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve received a brand-new trailer and a release date of October 2, 2026.

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is part of the celebration of the franchise turning 30 years old, and this entry takes place in July 2029.

The Federation of Central Usea (FCU) has fallen under the attack by the Republic of Sotoa, and you are left adrift aboard an aging aircraft carrier known as the Endurance. Your mission - reclaim your homeland.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Release Date Trailer | State of Play 2026

description:
Silent Hill: Townfall is officially coming out on PlayStation 5 on September 24, 2026, and the State of Play provided a brand-new look at the horror game set on St. Amelia.

#IGN #Gaming #PS5
title: Silent Hill: Townfall - Official Release Date Trailer| State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dynasty Warriors fans, rejoice! The game that brought the modern DW formula to prominence is getting a remaster and port.

First released in 2001, players will be able to take part in over 1,000 battles, fully remastered for the PlayStation 5, even playing as Ziluan from Dynasty Warriors: Origins.

Dynasty Warriors 3 - Complete Edition: Remastered comes to PS5 on October 1, 2026.
title: Dynasty Warriors 3 - Complete Edition: Remastered - Official Reveal Trailer | State of Play 2026

description:
Stand against the Genma and explore Kyoto, even facing off against Musashi's rival; Sasaki Ganryu.

The demo for Onimusha: Way of the Sword is available now on PS5, and playing gets you the Kubi Akari charm.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Demo Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Will you use human souls to fight against the overwhelming might of the Oni, Miyamoto Musashi?

Onimusha: Way of the Sword comes to PlayStation 5 on September 25.

Pre-order to obtain the Sealed Curse sword appearance and the Lion Dog charm.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Release Date Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The game that made Lara a legend is being remade. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5 for PS5, Lara will travel the world to unlock the secrets of an artifact from Atlantis. She'll have to stay ahead of rivals, survive rampaging dinosaurs, and much more if she wants to come home alive.

Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis comes to PlayStation on Feb. 12, 2027.
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official Release Date Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Spice must flow in open-world survival RPG, Dune: Awakening.

Discover new technology, uncover the secrets of the Fremen, and survive in the harsh deserts of Arrakis, now with the option for a brand-new single-player mode, when Dune: Awakening comes to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S on September 22, 2026.
title: Dune: Awakening - Official Console Announcement Story Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out an extended look at gameplay of Kemuri: Hunt the Unseen, which will be released on PlayStation 5 in 2027.

Kemuri is described as a Yokai Possession Action Game about "taking that first step into the unknown." In the game, players will venture to Kemuri City, which is the closest to the afterlife. You will become a Yokai Hunter and use the Fox Window to reveal what others can not see, make contracts with yokai, and even wear their power as Possession Apparel. Oh, and you can play solo or with 3 players in co-op.
title: Kemuri: Hunt the Unseen - Official Gameplay Trailer | State of Play 2026

description: It takes time to create a masterpiece, and behind every masterpiece is a master that took even longer to mature. Fish, wash dishes, and cook your way to mastery in Bancho the Chef.
title: Bancho the Chef - Wishlist Trailer | State of Play 2026

description:
Take a look at the Season 2 Overview Trailer for Marathon, the hit first-person extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players can get the rundown on Season 2, which is packed with the new Night Marsh map that turns the Dire Marsh map into night, introduces new enemies from the shadows of Tau Ceti 4, and heightens UESC opposition. See what else Season 2 has in store for Marathon, available now for a free week on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#Marathon #Gaming #IGN

Music by ‪JVLIAH‬

description:
Don't miss the launch trailer for the new season of Rainbow Six Siege, Operation System Override! Featuring an overhaul to the Ranked Mode, an all new map; The Calypso Casino, and a remaster of the operator Dokkaebi, introduced in Operation White Noise in 2017. 
Operation System Override is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Ubisoft Connect, Steam)
title: Rainbow Six Siege - Official Operation System Override Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for Fatekeeper, a first-person hack-and-slash action RPG developed by Paraglacial. Players will explore a fantastical world full of relics, spells, and key decisions to be made throughout the adventure. Master sword and sorcery in Fatekeeper, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Fatekeeper - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Season 4 Launch Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest addition to the first-person shooter franchise developed by Treyarch. Players will get a look at what's in store with the latest season, including a revamped Fortune's Keep, new multiplayer maps, Rogue Run in Zombies, and more. Season 4 for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is launching on June 4.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Official Season 4 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Game of Thrones: Dragonfire, a free-to-play mobile strategy game based on the acclaimed HBO original drama series, House of the Dragon, developed by WB Games. Players will strategically raise dragons, assemble an unbeatable empire, and claim the Iron Throne with ease. Game of Thrones: Dragonfire is available now for iOS and Android.
title: Game of Thrones: Dragonfire - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for Toy Story: Retro Roundup & Toy Story 3: Complete Edition! An all in one package bringing together the classic Toy Story games from the original Sega Genesis release from 1995 all the way to Toy Story Racer in 2001, including A Bugs Life as an additional bonus game! 
The other part of this surprise announcement was Toy Story 3 Complete Edition coming to modern consoles with improved resolution, textures and framerate!
title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup & Toy Story 3: Complete Edition - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this latest entry in Infinity Ward's "From The Ward" video series detailing the development of Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4! This time around, we're looking at how the talented audio team at Infinity Ward capture the realistic sound effects that help immerse you into the world of Modern Warfare 4. 

Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23rd 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official "From The Ward Ep.4" Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Senna gameplay reveal trailer for 2XKO, the 2v2 Tag Fighter developed by Riot Games! Senna wields both light and dark, both having their uses in combat with light featuring more projectile heavy zoning, while dark allows Senna to rush her opponent down. 
Senna joins the 2XKO roster on June 9th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: 2XKO - Official Senna Gameplay Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this brand new trailer for Where Winds Meet 2nd expansion, The Imperial Palace. 
Imperial Palace Chapter II unlocks on June 8 (UTC)! See you there! Explore a massive new 1-million-square-meter region filled with strange wonders, palace secrets, and fierce battles... Venture deep behind the high walls to discover what awaits.
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Imperial Palace Chapter 2 Expansion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Behind-the-Scenes Reveal for Clutch, an upcoming open-world action racing game developed by Maverick Games. Players will embody a pair of siblings competing in the R1K Racing Series with the fastest cars on the track for the highest honors granted to the racer who reigns victorious. Hear from the developers on the creation of Clutch by way of Unreal Engine 5, providing unmatched fidelity, texture quality, and more. Clutch is also set to have unmatched customization and crash physics. Clutch is coming soon, with a full reveal on June 5.
title: Clutch - Official Behind-the-Scenes Reveal

Keep an eye out as the full species reveal theHunter: Call of the Wild Peru Hunting Reserve DLC will be shown on June 5th!
title: theHunter: Call of the Wild - Official Peru Hunting Reserve DLC Trailer

title: Bonehold - Official Release Window Trailer

description: Blast your way through Hell in Arms of God, the imminent bullet heaven roguelite auto-shooter that's clearly been inspired (in a good way!) by Doom. Wishlist it if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100310/Arms_of_God/
title: Arms of God - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
